title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Destination Security: Hold After a Destination Replacement
content:
**Destination security schedule — Cartwise Shopper Payouts, instant cashouts to an external debit card**

**Rule.** A new-destination hold is kept back on an instant cashout to an external debit card:

- where the destination was replaced fewer than 30 days ago (counted in calendar days from the moment of the replacement, or from the opening date when it was never replaced) and the account was verified 12 or more whole months ago, 10 percent of the balance is kept back, rounded to the cent;
- where the destination was replaced fewer than 30 days ago and the account was verified fewer than 12 whole months ago, a fixed 50.00 is kept back;
- otherwise nothing is kept back.

The hold stays on the payout balance and is not sent in the cashout.

**Terms.**
- *Days since the destination was replaced* — calendar days from the recorded moment the current bank account or debit card replaced the one before it; on an account whose destination was never replaced, calendar days from the account's opening date.
- *Months since verification* — whole months from the account's verification date to the day of the cashout.
- *The balance* — the unpaid earnings balance shown on the payout account when the cashout is worked out; the 10 percent is a share of that balance.

**Combinations.**

| Destination replaced | Verified 12 or more whole months ago | Verified fewer than 12 whole months ago |
|---|---|---|
| fewer than 30 days ago | 10 percent of the balance, rounded to the cent | fixed 50.00 |
| 30 or more days ago | nothing | nothing |

**Hypothetical cases.**
- Destination replaced 29 days ago; account verified 3 years ago; balance 412.35. 10 percent of 412.35 is 41.235, kept back as 41.24.
- Destination replaced 29 days ago; account verified 7 months ago: 50.00 kept back, whatever the balance.
- Destination replaced exactly 30 days ago: not fewer than 30, so nothing is kept back.
- Destination never replaced; account opened 20 days ago and verified 18 days ago: the opening date is fewer than 30 days back and verification fewer than 12 whole months back, so 50.00 is kept back.
